title: Access Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS)
text: browse interactively Positron RStudio Connections pane:
code: library(wrds)  wrds <- wrds_connect()  # Discover available data list_subscriptions(wrds) list_tables(wrds, "comp")  # Inspect table structure describe_table(wrds, "comp", "funda", max_cols = 5) #> comp.funda #> Rows: 929,001 #> Columns: 948 #> $ gvkey    <chr>  "001000", "001000", "001000", "001000", "001000", ... #> $ datadate <date> 1961-12-31, 1962-12-31, 1963-12-31, 1964-12-31, ... #> $ fyear    <int>  1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967, 1968, 1969, ... #> $ indfmt   <chr>  "INDL", "INDL", "INDL", "INDL", "INDL", "INDL", "INDL", ... #> $ consol   <chr>  "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", ... #> # ... with 943 more columns library(connections) connection_view(wrds)

title: Access Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS)
text: Pre-built functions common datasets:
code: # Compustat annual fundamentals (North America) funda <- get_compustat(wrds,   start_date = "2024-01-01",   end_date = "2025-12-31" )  # Compustat quarterly (Global) g_fundq <- get_compustat(wrds,   frequency = "quarterly",   region = "global",   start_date = "2025-01-01" )  # Company header data (SIC, NAICS, state, etc.) company <- get_company(wrds)  # Linking tables ccm <- link_ccm(wrds) ibes_link <- link_ibes_crsp(wrds)  # Preview before downloading preview <- get_compustat(wrds, n = 100)  # Historical SIC codes are included by default get_compustat(wrds, n = 100) |> dplyr::count(sich) #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>    sich     n #>   <int> <int> #> 1  4841     1 #> 2  5080    24 #> 3  5712     3 #> 4    NA    72  # Fill missing historical SIC codes with SIC from comp.company get_compustat(wrds, fill_sic = TRUE, n = 100) |> dplyr::count(sic) #> # A tibble: 8 × 2 #>   sic       n #>   <chr> <int> #> 1 3089     17 #> 2 3825     13 #> 3 3949      3 #> 4 4841      2 #> 5 4911      1 #> 6 5080     46 #> 7 5712     10 #> 8 5812      8  wrds_disconnect(wrds)

title: Access Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS)
text: Access table build queries dplyr:
code: # Filter CRSP monthly returns for specific stocks big_tech <- c(14593, 90319, 13407)  # Apple, Alphabet, Meta get_table(wrds, "crsp", "msf") |>   filter(permno %in% big_tech, date >= "2020-01-01") |>   select(permno, date, ret, prc, shrout) |>   collect()  # Lazy queries for large datasets get_compustat(wrds, lazy = TRUE) |>   filter(fyear >= 2000) |>   select(gvkey, datadate, at, sale) |>   collect()

title: Access Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS)
text: get_compustat() applies standard research filters default. can customize specialized analyses: Default filters region: inspect default columns table names frequency/region combination:
code: # Financial services firms (banks, insurance, etc.) # Default indfmt = "INDL" excludes these get_compustat(wrds, indfmt = "FS", n = 100)  # Include non-consolidated statements # Default consol = "C" returns only consolidated get_compustat(wrds, consol = "B", n = 100)  # Add columns beyond the defaults get_compustat(wrds, add_columns = c("emp"), n = 100)  # Specify your own column list (replaces defaults) get_compustat(wrds, columns = c("gvkey", "datadate", "at", "lt", "seq"), n = 100) wrds:::compustat_config("annual", "na") wrds:::compustat_config("quarterly", "global")

title: Download Compustat company header data — get_company
text: sic column contains "header" SIC code, company's recent SIC classification stored character. historical SIC codes change time, use get_compustat() fill_sic = TRUE, coalesces historical sich (integer) header sic.

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ wrds <- wrds_connect()  # Get company header data company <- get_company(wrds)  # Get global companies g_company <- get_company(wrds, region = "global")  # Lazy query get_company(wrds, lazy = TRUE) |>   dplyr::filter(sic == "7370") |>   dplyr::collect()  wrds_disconnect(wrds) } # }

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
text: Downloads financial statement data Compustat standard filters clean, analysis-ready data.

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
code: get_compustat(   wrds,   frequency = c("annual", "quarterly"),   region = c("na", "global"),   start_date = NULL,   end_date = NULL,   columns = NULL,   add_columns = NULL,   indfmt = "INDL",   consol = "C",   fill_sic = FALSE,   n = Inf,   lazy = FALSE )

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
text: wrds DBIConnection object returned wrds_connect(). frequency One "annual" (default) "quarterly". region One "na" (North America, default) "global". start_date Start date filtering. Character string "YYYY-MM-DD" format Date object. Defaults NULL (filter). end_date End date filtering. Character string "YYYY-MM-DD" format Date object. Defaults NULL (filter). columns Character vector columns return, replacing defaults. Use describe_table() see available columns. add_columns Character vector additional columns include beyond defaults. Ignored columns specified. indfmt Industry format filter. Defaults "INDL" (industrial). Use "FS" financial services format. consol Consolidation level. Defaults "C" (consolidated). Use "B" consolidated non-consolidated. fill_sic TRUE, fills missing historical SIC codes (sich) header SIC codes comp.company. supported North America. used lazy = TRUE, returns table sich without join (requires manual joining get_company()). Defaults FALSE. n Maximum number rows return. Defaults Inf (rows). Use smaller value (e.g., n = 100) preview data downloading full table. lazy TRUE, returns lazy tbl instead collecting. Defaults FALSE.

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
text: tibble Compustat fundamentals. Default columns vary region: North America (comp.funda / comp.fundq): Identifiers: gvkey, cusip, tic, conm, datadate Time: fyear/fyearq, fyr/fqtr Income: ni/niq, ib/ibq, oiadp/oiadpq, revt/revtq Balance sheet: /atq, lt/ltq, seq/seqq, ceq/ceqq Market: csho/cshoq, prcc_f/prccq : sale/saleq, capx/capxy, che/cheq, dlc/dlcq, dltt/dlttq Industry: sich (historical SIC); sic (fill_sic = TRUE, coalesced sich header SIC) Global (comp.g_funda / comp.g_fundq): Identifiers: gvkey, isin, conm, datadate Geography: loc, fic, exchg Similar financial variables (differences, e.g., nit/nitq instead ni/niq)

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
text: Default filters follow standard practice research applications. Region-specific filters applied automatically based region: datafmt: "STD" North America, "HIST_STD" Global popsrc: "D" (domestic) North America, "" (international) Global North America Global data different structures combined without careful column harmonization.

title: Download Compustat fundamentals — get_compustat
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ wrds <- wrds_connect()  # Annual North America fundamentals funda <- get_compustat(wrds)  # Quarterly with date filter fundq <- get_compustat(wrds,   frequency = "quarterly",   start_date = "2020-01-01",   end_date = "2023-12-31" )  # Global annual g_funda <- get_compustat(wrds, region = "global")  # Lazy query for further filtering get_compustat(wrds, lazy = TRUE) |>   dplyr::filter(fyear >= 2020) |>   dplyr::select(gvkey, datadate, at, lt) |>   dplyr::collect()  # Fill missing SIC codes with header SIC from comp.company funda_sic <- get_compustat(wrds, fill_sic = TRUE)  # Preview first 100 rows before full download preview <- get_compustat(wrds, n = 100)  wrds_disconnect(wrds) } # }

NULL (default), returns columns. Use describe_table() see available columns. n Maximum number rows return. Defaults Inf (rows). title: Download data from any WRDS table — get_table

title: Download data from any WRDS table — get_table
text: function provides generic access WRDS table. commonly-used tables standard research filters, prefer specialized functions: get_compustat() Compustat fundamentals standard filters get_company() company header data link_ccm() CRSP-Compustat linking lazy table can filtered, selected, mutated using dplyr verbs, translated SQL executed server:
code: get_table(wrds, "crsp", "msf") |>   filter(date >= "2025-01-01") |>   select(permno, date, ret, prc) |>   collect()

title: Download data from any WRDS table — get_table
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ wrds <- wrds_connect()  # Preview table structure first describe_table(wrds, "crsp", "msf")  # Get a lazy table and build your query get_table(wrds, "crsp", "msf") |>   dplyr::filter(date >= "2025-01-01") |>   dplyr::select(permno, date, ret, prc, vol) |>   dplyr::collect()  # Collect immediately with specific columns get_table(wrds, "crsp", "dsf",   columns = c("permno", "date", "ret", "prc"),   lazy = FALSE,   n = 1000 )  # Access any table in any library get_table(wrds, "ibes", "statsum_epsus") |>   dplyr::filter(fpedats >= "2025-01-01") |>   dplyr::collect()  wrds_disconnect(wrds) } # }

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
text: Downloads CCM (CRSP-Compustat Merged) linking table maps CRSP PERMNOs Compustat GVKEYs valid date ranges.

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
code: link_ccm(   wrds,   linktype = c("LC", "LU", "LS"),   linkprim = c("P", "C"),   n = Inf,   lazy = FALSE )

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
text: wrds DBIConnection object returned wrds_connect(). linktype Character vector. Types links include. Defaults c("LC", "LU", "LS"): "LC": Link confirmed Compustat "LU": Link unconfirmed (valid less certain) "LS": Link valid secondary securities linkprim Character vector. Link primacy filters. Defaults c("P", "C"): "P": Primary link identified Compustat "C": Primary link identified CRSP n Maximum number rows return. Defaults Inf (rows). Use smaller value (e.g., n = 100) preview data downloading full table. lazy TRUE, returns lazy tbl instead collecting. Defaults FALSE.

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
text: tibble columns: gvkey Compustat company identifier permno CRSP permanent security identifier linkdt Start date link linkenddt End date link (missing values replaced max date) linktype Type link linkprim Link primacy

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
text: linking table comes crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist. Missing linkenddt values indicate ongoing links replaced maximum date table easier date-range joins. use link, join gvkey ensure observation date falls within linkdt linkenddt range.

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
text: Ian Gow, Financial Accounting Research, Chapter Identifiers: https://iangow.github.io/far_book/identifiers.html

title: Get CRSP-Compustat linking table — link_ccm
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ wrds <- wrds_connect() ccm <- link_ccm(wrds)  # Join with Compustat data compustat <- get_compustat(wrds) compustat |>   dplyr::inner_join(ccm, by = dplyr::join_by(gvkey)) |>   dplyr::filter(datadate >= linkdt, datadate <= linkenddt)  wrds_disconnect(wrds) } # }

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
text: Downloads WRDS-provided linking table maps IBES tickers CRSP PERMNOs valid date ranges match quality scores.

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
code: link_ibes_crsp(wrds, max_score = 5L, n = Inf, lazy = FALSE)

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
text: wrds DBIConnection object returned wrds_connect(). max_score Maximum match quality score include. Defaults 5, excludes score 6 (worst matches). Lower scores indicate better matches: 1: Best match (CUSIP, ticker, company name match) 2-5: Progressively weaker matches 6: Worst match (excluded default) n Maximum number rows return. Defaults Inf (rows). Use smaller value (e.g., n = 100) preview data downloading full table. lazy TRUE, returns lazy tbl instead collecting. Defaults FALSE.

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
text: tibble columns: ticker IBES ticker permno CRSP permanent security identifier sdate Start date link edate End date link score Match quality score (1 = best, 6 = worst)

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
text: linking table comes wrdsapps_link_crsp_ibes.ibcrsphist. use link, join ticker ensure observation date falls within sdate edate range.

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
text: WRDS IBES-CRSP Linking Table Documentation: https://wrds-www.wharton.upenn.edu/documents/796/IBES_CRSP_Linking_Table_by_WRDS.pdf

title: Get IBES-CRSP linking table — link_ibes_crsp
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ wrds <- wrds_connect() ibes_link <- link_ibes_crsp(wrds)  # Join with IBES data on ticker and date range ibes_data |>   dplyr::inner_join(ibes_link, by = dplyr::join_by(ticker)) |>   dplyr::filter(date >= sdate, date <= edate)  wrds_disconnect(wrds) } # }
